resources.string: NoXXX uses Accessibility to check browser addresses against its blocklist, close blocked apps, scan the screen on-device for explicit images, and stop its own protection from being switched off during a cool-off. Nothing is sent off your device.
Prevents NoXXX from being uninstalled without completing the cool-off first.
That NoXXX setting is locked. Request an unlock in NoXXX to change it.
Turning this off removes uninstall protection. Use the cool-off in NoXXX instead.
